chunks.text: Today we will talk about Mozambique.
Mozambique is a warm, beautiful and friendly country in Southern Africa.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Mozambique?
Mozambique is in Southeastern Africa.
It is next to Tanzania, Malawi, Zambia, Zimbabwe, South Africa and Eswatini.
To the east it touches the Indian Ocean.
Mozambique has long beaches, islands and coastal towns.
What is the capital city of Mozambique?
The capital city is Maputo.
Maputo is a large port city by the sea.
It has markets, museums, parks and colorful buildings.
The people in Maputo are friendly and love music and seafood.
Other cities include Beira Nampoula, Kalimani, Pemba.
How many people live in Mozambique?
About 33 million people live in Mozambique.
Most people live near the coast or in villages.
Mozambique has a young population.
Many people are under 25 years old.
What language do people speak in Mozambique?
The official language is Portuguese.
Many people also speak local African languages such as Makua Senatsanga.
In schools and cities, some people also speak a little English.
What is the weather like in Mozambique?
Mozambique has a tropical climate, hot and wet from November to March, dry and cooler from April to October.
The weather is good for farming, fishing and beach life.
What does Mozambique look like?
Mozambique has long beaches and blue ocean, green hills and rivers, forests and islands, villages, farms and wildlife parks.
It is a country full of natural beauty and smiling people.
What animals live in Mozambique?
In Mozambique, you can find elephants, lions, hippos and zebras, crocodiles and monkeys, sea turtles, dolphins and whales, colorful birds, fish and insects.
There are many national parks to protect animals.
What do people eat in Mozambique?
Mozambican food is spicy, fresh and often made with seafood.

People eat rice, cassava and maize porridge, fish, shrimp and crab, beans, tomatoes and greens, coconut and peanuts, popular dishes, metapa, cassava leaves with coconut and peanuts, peary peary chicken, spicy grilled chicken, shima, maize porridge, grilled fish with rice and salad.
What do people drink in Mozambique?
People drink water, tea and coffee, fruit juice like mango or pineapple.
Adults may drink palm wine or local beer.
In hot weather, cold drinks are very popular.
What is life like in Mozambique?
Life in Mozambique is often simple, busy and community based.
People enjoy fishing and farming, spending time with family, going to church or mosque, dancing, singing and playing music, watching football, the favorite sport.
People in villages live in small houses made of mud, brick or wood.
What are some holidays and traditions in Mozambique?
Independence Day, June 25, Heroes Day, February 3, Christmas and New Year with music and food, Eid celebrated by Muslim families, local festivals with drums, traditional dance and colorful clothes.
Music and dance are very important in everyday life.
Some fun facts about Mozambique.
Mozambique's flag has a book, a gun and a hoe.
The country was a colony of Portugal until 1975.
Mozambique Island is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The Bazarudo Archipelago is famous for beaches and sea life.
The local currency is called the medical.
Now you know many things about Mozambique.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the sea, the animals and the traditions.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
See you next time.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in Portuguese.
Ciao.
